name: Half Marble Box
description: Boxes filled with half-marbles. A half can't be sorted on its own — two halves of the same color must meet on the belt and combine into one full marble first.
howToPlay: Tap the open boxes on the bottom row to drop their 3 half-marbles onto the belt. They circle but slide past the trays. When two halves of the same color are on the belt together, they snap into one full marble — which then drops into its matching tray. Emptying a box opens the ghost box above it, holding the other halves you need. Clear every tray to win!
author: Claude

showcaseLevel.name: Two Halves Make a Whole
showcaseLevel.desc: Combine matching half-marbles on the belt to complete them.
